newsitem.title: DENMARK: FLS wins Danish pollution control order.
newsitem.headline: FLS wins Danish pollution control order.

text.p: Danish engineering and cement group FLS Industries said on Monday its environmental unit won a 90 million crown order to supply new air pollution control systems for Denmark's Kommunekemi A/S.
It said the contract covered the supply of two complete plants for cleaning flue gas emitted from Kommunekemi kilns at its factory in central Denmark used for the incineration of hazardous waste.
The first new plant was scheduled to start up in late 1998, with the second due to go on line one year later, FLS said.
